feedback.finish: In 1605, a group of Catholics tried to blow up King James I with a dangerous explosive called gunpowder. This is now called the Gunpowder Plot.

instruction.text: Select James I to learn why the Catholics didn’t like him.

feedback.finish: There were two main types of Christianity in the 1600s: the Church of England and Catholicism. James I was the head of the Church of England, so he punished anyone who was Catholic.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to hear the conversation between the plotters.

atoms.b: My name is Guy Fawkes. I heard about your ((++plot pot)) and I would like to help.
I am Robert Catesby, the leader of the ((++Gunpowder Sugar)) Plot. Why do you want to join us?
atoms.sound: I am Robert Katesbee, the leader of the Gunpowder Plot. Why do you want to join us?

atoms.b: I am also a ((++Catholic Protestant)) and I don’t like how King James is treating us. What is your plan?
We are going to ((++blow_up paint)) the Houses of Parliament when the king is visiting and kill him.

hint.label: Houses of Parliament
hint.text: The Houses of Parliament are where laws are discussed in the UK.

atoms.b: What a good idea! I can certainly help with the ((++gunpowder food)). After my time fighting in the Catholic Spanish army, I’m an explosives expert!

instruction.text: On which date did the plotters plan to blow up the Houses of Parliament?

feedback.finish: Guy Fawkes, Robert Catesby and the eleven other plotters wanted to blow up the Houses of Parliament on the 5th of November, when King James was going to be there.

instruction.text: Drag the barrels of gunpowder into the underground cellar.

feedback.finish: The plotters wanted to put barrels of gunpowder under Parliament. They first tried digging a tunnel, but this was really difficult. Luckily for them, they were able to rent a cellar instead!
